summary: Manasquan is the clear winner today — prime ESE swell to 3ft with cross-off wind, the best conditions anywhere this week and worth the drive from Rockaway. Home break gets the same prime angle and size but a cross-on SW ruins it past dawn, so patrol early or aim south. After a flat, windy weekend, Manasquan lights up again clean on Monday and Tuesday — that's your next drive; everything else stays small.
